subject: Acceptance headers, prebill hold policy and sequenced billing
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.o@blueoak.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@blueoak.com
Date: 2027-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Billing cadence & PO acceptance headers (BlueOak renewal)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the routing controls. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of constraints before we finalize the renewal:

1) PO acceptance header: our AP system requires a distinct PO-ACK header (PO-ACK: yes) in invoice metadata to automatically match invoices to the PO.
2) Prebill hold: for our larger monthly commitments we occasionally place a 7-business-day prebill hold when contracts cross financial cutovers; we need to know if Redwood can honor a prebill flag and return a discrete hold code back to our system.
3) Invoicing cadence: we prefer weekly invoice runs (every Friday) rather than a single monthly statement when usage exceeds $100k/month. Can Redwood support sequenced weekly billing under the same PO?

Finally — discount eligibility: our finance team needs confirmation that you will honor the committed discount slab if we split invoices across weekly runs (same PO). If splitting invalidates the slab, we'll need to surface a workaround.

Can you confirm by EOD Monday? Attaching BlueOak's procurement template for reference.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement — BlueOak Health
Attachment: BlueOak_PO_Template_Signed.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.o@blueoak.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-20T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Billing cadence & PO acceptance headers (BlueOak renewal)

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up-front, then a proposed play:

- PO-ACK header: yes, we can emit a PO-ACK metadata flag on invoices (we already support configurable remit/PO headers). We will confirm exact header name and sample in our invoice payload.
- Prebill hold: we can accept a prebill flag. Our billing pipeline can tag invoices with a "PREBILL_HOLD" code and expose that in the invoice webhook. The 7-business-day hold is fine; we'll treat it as a hold state until release.
- Weekly sequenced runs: supported. We can drive weekly invoicing under one master PO by sequencing invoice runs and adding a sequence_id field so your ERP can stitch them.

About the discount: by default our discount eligibility check runs at billing reconciliation (monthly). To preserve the committed slab across weekly runs, we can either: 1) evaluate eligibility at month close (aggregate weekly runs), or 2) mark each weekly invoice with a provisional discount token and reconcile at month-end with an adjustment invoice. Option 1 is revenue-neutral for you and simpler operationally; option 2 gives immediate visibility but may generate small credit adjustments.

Proposed next step: I will loop finance to align on the reconciliation approach and share a short prebill matrix that details states and sample headers. If that works, I'll send a short SOW addendum to include the prebill hold behavior and sequencing.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachment: prebill_matrix_v1.xlsx

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-20T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: BlueOak prebill & discount handling (asks from procurement)

Karthik / Marissa — looping in finance ops (Marissa) to validate the reconciliation flow. A couple of internal notes:

- Finance preference is option 1 (aggregate at month close) to avoid chasing small adjustments; we should confirm whether BlueOak requires immediate invoice-level discount visibility for their internal reporting.
- Need engineering to confirm the exact invoice webhook schema for PREBILL_HOLD + sequence_id + PO-ACK. If engineering needs formal requirements, we'll convert Liam's template and our prebill matrix into a ticket.

Marissa — can you confirm if our billing system can tag sequence_id and hold_code without changing existing GL mapping? If not, we can do a small mapping tweak under the SOW.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.o@blueoak.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-22T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Billing cadence & PO acceptance headers (BlueOak renewal)

Liam — quick confirmation after internal alignment:

1) PO-ACK header: Redwood will emit PO-ACK: yes as a top-level invoice header. Sample header and payload: [stubbed here] — we'll share full sample in the drive link.
2) Prebill hold: we will support PREBILL_HOLD with a 7-business-day automatic release or manual release via the billing console. Hold events will appear in the invoice webhook with hold_code=PREBILL_7BD.
3) Weekly invoicing under one PO: supported. We will include sequence_id and week_number on each invoice so your ERP can reconcile.
4) Discount eligibility: we will validate eligibility at month close (Option 1) and apply committed slab discounts on the final reconciliation invoice. If the monthly total meets the slab, no negative adjustments will be issued to BlueOak; if it does not, final invoicing reflects the correct slab.

Attached is the prebill_matrix_v1.xlsx with the hold states and a sample invoice header. If BlueOak needs immediate per-invoice discount visibility, we can enable provisional tokens (Option 2) but that will be captured in the SOW as an optional bill-run enhancement.

Next step: I will share a short SOW addendum (1 page) that lists the header names, hold behavior, and the weekly sequencing. Please confirm acceptance and we'll kick off the integration ticket.

Best,
Karthik
Attachment: prebill_matrix_v1.xlsx
